question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 20 days and B can do the same job in 16 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the job in 20 days.

B can complete the job in 16 days.

A, B, and C together complete the job in 3 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done per day = 1 ÷ Number of days.

Total work = Work rate × Time.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work rate of A = 1 ÷ 20 = 1/20.

⇒ Work rate of B = 1 ÷ 16 = 1/16.

⇒ Combined work rate of A, B, and C = 1 ÷ 3 = 1/3.

⇒ Work rate of C = Combined work rate - (Work rate of A + Work rate of B).

⇒ Work rate of C = 1/3 - (1/20 + 1/16).

⇒ Work rate of C = 1/3 - (4/80 + 5/80).

⇒ Work rate of C = 1/3 - 9/80.

⇒ Work rate of C = (80 ÷ 240) - (27 ÷ 240).

⇒ Work rate of C = 53 ÷ 240.

⇒ Time taken by C = 1 ÷ Work rate of C.

⇒ Time taken by C = 240 ÷ 53.

⇒ Time taken by C = 4(28)/(53) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4(28)/(53) days.**
